item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i sbyin sreg me yi dbal 'khor gyi sham bu sreg byed ye shes dzo dmar 'khyil pa
item.coloph: de ltar dbal phur me mchod shams bu 'di/ mi 'gyur tshe dbang grags pa'i bka' byung nas/ thos bsam nor gyis dbul bdag g.yung drung rgyal gyis/ gang dran tho shar thar bde dben rir bris//
